panels.title: Blocked-question rate
panels.description: Share of the questions agents put to the operator that the question gate refused (blocked, plus refused-but-let-through at the turn's refusal limit), over the selected window. Source: csf_harness_questions_total, counted afresh from every run's event log at each scrape of the harness's /metrics. Corpus baseline before the gate (2026-10-05 replay, n=140): every question would have been refused, since none named an operator class.

panels.title: Override rate (false positives, lower bound)
panels.description: Sends on which the operator said they wanted a question the gate refused (question_wanted), over refused questions. Only a refusal the operator hears of can be overridden, so this bounds the gate's false-positive rate from below. Corpus upper bound (2026-10-05 replay): 20 of 140 questions drew an answer, 14%.

panels.title: Questions by class and verdict
panels.description: Questions over the selected window by the class the gate placed them in (meaning, trust boundary, class membership; or magnitude, fact, authorized, default, re-litigation, unnamed) and verdict (passed, blocked, limit). gate=question is an AskUserQuestion call judged before it was shown; gate=reply is the questions a reply ended on.
